paper.title: A New Wake Model and Comparison of Eight Algorithms for Layout Optimization of Wind Farms in Complex Terrain

paper_native_problem.objective: maximize sum over turbine and sector of local probability times effective_speed/reference_speed

public_proxy.source_dataset: ParqueFicticio WAsP 30 m and 200 m grids
public_proxy.transformation: interpolate to 67 m and affinely map to the paper's 6000 m by 4000 m domain
public_proxy.claim_boundary: same-lineage open flow-field proxy, not the private Northwest-China site

double_stage_rs.driver_basis: random search in the target paper and Algorithm 1 of DOI 10.1016/j.renene.2015.01.005
double_stage_rs.stage_1: ignore wakes for 5000 paper CPU seconds
double_stage_rs.stage_2: include wakes for 20000 paper CPU seconds
double_stage_rs.initial_layouts: one Figure-2 digitization plus ten random feasible layouts
double_stage_rs.fixed_work_admission: explicit stage1_fes and stage2_fes; every complete 12-sector farm objective is one physical FES

missing_information: private Northwest-China terrain and WAsP CFD grids
turbine power and CT arrays except CT=0.747 at 7 m/s
toolbox settings, seeds, histories, and portable stopping budget

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: Table 2 displays speed and direction units in swapped columns
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: follow the quantities and equations rather than the swapped unit labels

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: paper-native terrain and flow fields are private
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: preserve every published equation and constraint but register the PyWake-derived field as an open proxy semantic ID

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: only CT=0.747 at 7 m/s is printed
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use a declared piecewise CT curve anchored exactly at the printed point

hpc_contract.parallel_axis: twelve independent wind sectors within each physical FES
hpc_contract.thread_lifecycle: one persistent worker team per optimization
hpc_contract.formal_outer_axis: independent initial layouts use remaining cores without nested oversubscription
hpc_contract.full_resource_policy: consume all currently available Waffle CPU resources across inner sector and outer independent-start axes

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of equations, domain, constraints, double-stage lifecycle, and open-proxy complex-terrain behavior; not the private Northwest-China benchmark or author-numerical replay
